what_this_is: Systems that consume this store's corpus and cite it by verify URL. Empty until one does. An entry is added only with a dated citation URL, and scripts/citations-check.mjs fetches that URL and fails when the citation is gone. The page at /scorers renders this file; nothing is typed there.
how_a_system_gets_listed: Five facts, all observable, none a judgment: (1) a public page of theirs, reachable by a plain unauthenticated GET, (2) cites a specific row — a verify URL, a corpus entry or host URL, or the cite shape — not merely a link to the store's front door, (3) the citation is live when the entry is written and the watch can read it, (4) the system is not this store, a mirror of its text, or a page it operates, and (5) the entry is name, citing URL and the date first seen, nothing else. Not required: permission, reciprocity, a partnership, any view on their quality, or payment. Listing is not endorsement in either direction, and the list is alphabetical by name.
how_an_entry_leaves: When the watch reads the citing page and finds no citation (`gone`), the build fails until the entry is removed or its URL updated; git keeps the history. A page that could not be read is `unreadable` and is not a finding.
ruled: 2026-09-04, the keeper: the criteria above, and the default of listing nothing until a citation exists.
